messages.subject: aesthetics for crossbars with mean_cl_boot
parts:
Hi, 

I'm very new to this, trying to follow the graphing method described here by Hadley Wickham. 

Pretty much, this should provide a graph with all data points as well as a sort of box plot for each group.

qplot(x,y,data=data,color=z)+stat_summary(fun="mean_cl_boot", conf.int=0.68,geom="crossbar", width=0.3)

But it returns the error:

Error: geom_crossbar requires the following missing aesthetics: y, ymin, ymax

How can have these values set to the median and 1st and 3rd quartiles?

Thanks for any help, I'm pretty sure this package will solve all my graphing needs, once I overcome this obstacle so I'm pretty excited.
